name: Celestial Witness

description.content: Every [30s], if the Obsession is at least [40m] away from you, you see their Aura for [3s]. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

quote: "And so the heretics huddled, cowardly, in the night; but tupon Judgement's arrival, It saw them all, and punished them." (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 32)
